body:
Review one at a time, in plain words (owner asked to save these for later, 2026-10-07).
1. WithoutOriginCheck lets reset and magic links point at any host: one-click account takeover (better-auth same; documented). Line-break and backslash refusal kept as a header-injection guard.
2. ReuseCodeOnResend: the default code is HMAC-derived from the row id under WithSecret; a GenerateCode code is stored sealed (AES-256-GCM) in auth_code.code_sealed (migration 0006). Database AND secret together read every open code.
3. Breaking API: phone sign-in now takes phone.SignInRequest.
4. Sign-up fields (auth.WithSignUpFields) are limited to the app's own WithUserColumns columns; top-level keys or nested fields object, both ways = auth.field_invalid.
5. KV verification store: cutoffs expire after max(7d, longest token issued); gap: a token issued by another process with a longer lifetime.
6. WithSecondaryStorage does not move verification tokens; WithVerificationStore is a separate opt-in (no transaction for non-SQL stores).
7. WeChat preset sends the app secret in the token URL (WeChat documents no other way).
8. Left for owner: hosted demo, in-docs AI chat, remote docs MCP server and npx installer, curated videos/blog posts.
9. CHANGELOG lines for r11-r14, round 6, r20, r21 are not yet written (see docsi/plans/compare/better-auth/briefs/review-builds.md and agent reports).
title: Owner review later: decisions made in round 6 and r20/r21 parity builds
